title: Musa and the Children of Israel
blurb: Egypt, Sinai and Jerusalem. The age of Musa, Dawud, Sulayman and Yunus, ending with exile in Babylon.

events.title: Shuayb and the traders
events.what: Shuayb tells the traders of Madyan to give full measure. They refuse and are destroyed by an earthquake.

events.title: Musa in the river
events.what: Pharaoh kills newborn boys of Bani Israil. Musa's mother sets him in the river. Pharaoh's wife raises him in the palace.

events.title: Musa flees to Madyan
events.what: Musa flees Egypt after an accidental killing, marries in Madyan and works there for ten years.

events.title: The fire at Tuwa
events.what: In the valley of Tuwa, Allah speaks to Musa, gives him the staff and the shining hand, and sends him with Harun to Pharaoh.

events.title: Musa before Pharaoh
events.what: Musa's staff swallows the magicians' tricks. The magicians believe. Plagues follow: locusts, lice, frogs, blood.

events.title: The sea parts
events.what: The sea splits for Bani Israil and closes on Pharaoh. His body is preserved as a sign.

events.title: The Tawrat and the calf
events.what: Musa spends forty nights on the mountain and receives the Tawrat. His people worship a golden calf while he is away.

events.title: The cow
events.what: Told to slaughter a cow, Bani Israil stall with question after question. A slain man is revived to name his killer.

events.title: Qarun
events.what: Qarun, rich beyond counting, boasts that he earned it all himself. The earth swallows him and his house.

events.title: Musa and al-Khidr
events.what: Musa travels to learn from al-Khidr. A boat holed, a boy killed, a wall rebuilt: each makes sense only at the end.

events.title: Forty years in the desert
events.what: Bani Israil refuse to enter the holy land. They wander forty years, fed with manna and quail.

events.title: Dawud and Jalut
events.what: Talut is made king. His small army is tested at a river. The young Dawud kills the giant Jalut.

events.title: King Dawud
events.what: Dawud becomes king and prophet. He receives the Zabur, softens iron, and the mountains praise Allah with him.

events.title: Sulayman's kingdom
events.what: Sulayman rules jinn, wind and birds. He builds the temple at Bayt al-Maqdis, the first qiblah.

events.title: The Queen of Sheba
events.what: The hoopoe reports a queen who worships the sun. Her throne is brought in a blink. The Queen of Sheba submits.

events.title: Ilyas against Baal
events.what: Ilyas calls his people away from the idol Baal. Al-Yasa continues his work.

events.title: Yunus and the whale
events.what: Yunus leaves Nineveh in anger and is swallowed by the whale. He repents. His city of 100,000 believes and is spared.

events.title: Nineveh falls
events.what: Babylon and the Medes destroy Nineveh. The Assyrian empire ends.

events.title: Exile to Babylon
events.what: Babylon burns the temple and takes Bani Israil into exile. Many scholars read this as the first punishment in Surah al-Isra.

events.title: A hundred years asleep
events.what: A man passes the ruined city and asks how it can live again. Allah makes him die a hundred years, then revives him. Many say he was Uzayr.
